content: Supabase Auth asymmetric JWT signing keys: verify locally via JWKS at https://<ref>.supabase.co/auth/v1/.well-known/jwks.json using kid; no Auth server round trip. JWKS is cached ~10 min at edge + 10 min in client libs (~20 min rotation lag); build cache busting for urgent revocation. Prefer supabase.auth.getClaims(); do not verify against the legacy HS256 shared secret. Rotation keeps both keys valid so no forced sign-out. Verified against supabase.com/docs/guides/auth/signing-keys.
